name: io.github.tonyyang0504/lazada_sponsored_solutions-mcp
description: Lazada Sponsored Solutions (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report, update_budget, pause_resume. Every

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_SPONSORED_SOLUTIONS_APP_KEY
environmentVariables.description: App Key of your Lazada Open Platform app with the Sponsored Solutions API permission (App Console).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_SPONSORED_SOLUTIONS_APP_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: App Secret of the same app; signs every call and the token refresh (uppercase hex HMAC-SHA256 over the API name + sorted name/value pairs). Never sent on the wire.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_SPONSORED_SOLUTIONS_REFRESH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Seller refresh_token from /auth/token/create after the seller authorised the app; the runtime mints access tokens with the signed /auth/token/refresh (https://auth.lazada.com/rest) and keeps the refresh_token it returns ('The refresh token cannot be refreshed': when refresh_expires_in runs out the seller must re-authorise). Set PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR so the newest one survives restarts.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LAZADA_SPONSORED_SOLUTIONS_API_DOMAIN
environmentVariables.description: Regional API host of the seller's venture: api.lazada.sg, api.lazada.com.my, api.lazada.com.ph, api.lazada.co.th, api.lazada.co.id or api.lazada.vn (Service Endpoints of each Sponsored Solutions API).
